idea: A frame-accurate study of the reference's structure, timing, light and type, with Pebble, a small desktop computer in the hero's place.

productDescription.form: a squat rounded-square brushed-aluminium box, 1.97 x 0.5 x 1.97 m in stage units (197 mm square, 50 mm tall), corner radius 0.16, a plain top, a thin black rubber foot ring underneath, a small white power light low on the front

motif.name: the hero object
motif.description: one object throughout; every vignette adds parts to it (limbs, wheels, arms, boosters) drawn with lib.shapes around lib.product, never replacing it

score.harmony: RMS per ~0.27 s in analysis.json; music from 0.1 s at about -21 dB RMS, a dip at 1.2-1.3 s, then -18 to -20 dB through the vignettes; percussive hits align with the transformations and the five launch cuts; silence after the logo cut
score.timbres: music and sound effects only; hits on every transformation and on each of the launch cuts

stage.shadow: soft, from upper-left, long and diffuse
stage.table: seamless white studio sweep, horizon about y 620

referenceTargets.structure: 14 segments, boundaries within 2 frames of the above; the five launch cuts at 0.42 s spacing
referenceTargets.type: lockup boxes within 4 px and 3% size; timing within 2 frames; logo and legal positions likewise, with a fictional mark and name of matching box widths
referenceTargets.light: ground luminance 165-180 in studio segments; a soft upper-left key and a long diffuse shadow under the object
referenceTargets.motion: one hero object throughout; each vignette adds parts to it rather than replacing it
referenceTargets.notMeasured: surface realism of the 3D characters and clouds
